# wallet/js/vendor/

`noble-secp256k1.min.js` is a vendored, browser-ready build of `@noble/secp256k1@1.7.1`.

The npm package ships only ESM (`lib/esm/index.js`) and CommonJS (`lib/index.js`) builds — no
UMD/global bundle — so it cannot be loaded directly via a classic `<script src>` tag (that was
previously pointed at the CDN's CommonJS file and threw `ReferenceError: exports is not defined`
in the browser).

This file was generated by taking jsDelivr's `+esm` bundle
(`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@noble/secp256k1@1.7.1/+esm`, itself built from the package's own
`lib/esm/index.js`) and replacing its trailing `export {...}` statement with an assignment to
`window.secp256k1`, wrapped in an IIFE so its internal helper names don't leak into global scope.
Everything else is the untouched, unminified-further output of that ESM build.

To regenerate (e.g. to bump the pinned version), fetch
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@noble/secp256k1@<version>/+esm`, strip the trailing
`export{a as X, b as Y, ...};` line, and replace it with:

```js
window.secp256k1 = {X: a, Y: b, ...};
```

then wrap the whole file body in `(function (global) { "use strict"; ...body...
global.secp256k1 = {...}; })(window);`.
